By downloading or opening Ultimate File Manager Pro from the Google Play Store, you accept these Terms. If you\'d prefer not to accept them, simply don\'t install or use the app.
Ultimate File Manager Pro is a free Android app — available on both phones and Android TV — packed with tools to keep your files organised and secure.
We\'ve built this app with care, but here are some important realities you should know before using it.
The app offers an optional \"Fuel the Developer\" Tip Jar — three one-time voluntary purchases that support development. Tips give you no extra features; the app is always fully free.
All transactions go through Google Play Billing. We never see your card or bank details.

Tip purchases are voluntary and processed by Google Play. Refund requests are handled directly by Google Play in accordance with their refund policy and applicable law, including the South African Consumer Protection Act. KiloWatch does not process refunds independently.
There are no subscriptions. Every tip is a one-time consumable purchase. You will never be charged automatically.
Tipping is entirely optional. All features remain available at no cost, forever.
The app supports connecting to a wide range of third-party cloud storage providers using the integrated RClone backend. When you use this feature, the following conditions apply:

string-array.name: tc_rclone_details
string-array.item: All network requests to RClone storage providers (such as Filen, Mega, and others) are performed directly from your device to the respective provider\'s endpoints. No data passes through KiloWatch servers.

Your RClone configuration profiles and passwords are encrypted on-device via the RClone RC backend and stored locally as rclone_encrypted.json in the app\'s private storage. You are solely responsible for securing your device to protect this file.

Your use of any RClone-integrated cloud storage is governed by the terms of service and privacy policy of that respective cloud provider. You must comply with their terms when accessing files through this app.
Because cloud provider APIs and endpoints can change without notice, we cannot guarantee that any specific RClone provider will remain accessible or function uninterrupted.

resources.string: Connecting to cloud drives via RClone is done directly from your phone or TV. We never see your cloud files or passwords. Your passwords are encrypted on your phone, and you are subject to the terms of whatever cloud provider you configure.

These Terms are governed by the laws of South Africa. Any disputes will be resolved under South African jurisdiction, without regard to conflict of law provisions.

string-array.name: tc_features
string-array.item: File Browser — browse, copy, move, rename, and delete files anywhere on your device.
Encrypted Vault — lock sensitive files behind AES-256-GCM encryption with your own PIN.
File Server — host an FTP or secure SFTP server directly on your device to share files across your local network.
Remote Management — manage files over your local Wi-Fi via a built-in HTTP server that supports uploading, downloading, and installing APKs remotely.
Network Shares — connect to SMB, FTP, and NFS servers on your local network to browse, download, and manage remote files.
Folder Sync — automatically back up local phone folders to an SMB or FTP network share on a schedule you choose (interval or specific time daily, weekly, or monthly).
Device Pairing — pair your mobile phone and Android TV over local Wi-Fi to transfer and install files.
ADB Terminal — connect to Android devices in Developer Mode over your local Wi-Fi using ADB (Android Debug Bridge) for direct shell access and advanced troubleshooting.
Built-in Viewers — view text files, PDFs, animated images (APNG, GIF, animated WebP, SVG and more), archives, and other formats directly within the app.
Advanced ZIP Support — create and extract password-protected and AES-encrypted ZIP archives.
Remote Screenshots — capture the screen of your paired Android TV over local Wi-Fi via ADB and save it directly to your phone\'s storage.
7Z Archive Support — extract 7Z archives with LZMA/LZMA2 compression.
File Search — quickly find files and folders across your device storage.
Storage Analyser — see a visual breakdown of what\'s using your storage space.
App Manager — view and manage all apps installed on your device, with debloat recommendations for pre-installed apps.
APK Installer — install Android apps and split APKs (XAPK) directly from files saved locally.
Elevated Access (Shizuku & ADB) — gain root-like access to manage system files and restricted directories without actually rooting your device.
Storage Indexer — create a local index of file metadata for instant searching and blazing fast browsing.
Storage Access Framework — other apps can access your files through UFM\'s document provider.
Tip Jar — optional one-time purchases to support the developer; the app is always free without tipping.
UFM Media Player — play audio and video files with background playback, notification controls, Picture-in-Picture mode, and playlist management.

string-array.name: tc_risk_details
string-array.item: We cannot guarantee zero data loss. Always keep backups of files that matter to you.
If you forget your PIN and Recovery Code, your encrypted files cannot be recovered — by anyone.
Installing APKs from unknown sources carries security risks. You take full responsibility for any APK files you install.
When hosting a File Server, FTP connections transmit data and credentials in plain text. Always use SFTP if you require secure, encrypted transfers.
Your network share credentials (host, username, password) are stored locally on your device. You are responsible for keeping your device secure.
Sync operations run in the background and may consume battery and data. Always verify your remote path before enabling sync — syncing to an incorrect folder may overwrite files on your network share.
Removing system apps based on debloat recommendations may affect device stability. Proceed with caution.

ADB pairing requires exchanging certificates between your device and the target device over your local Wi-Fi. Only connect to devices you own or have permission to access. Anyone on your network who captures your pairing PIN can access your device — keep this PIN private.

Using Shizuku or ADB for elevated access allows the app to modify system-protected files. Misuse of these features could affect device stability or security. Use with caution and only grant access to this app.

Screenshots of paired TVs are captured via ADB over your local network and saved directly to your phone\'s storage. We do not transmit, view, or upload your screenshots. Ensure you only capture screens on devices you own or have permission to access.
The index reflects the state of your storage at the time of scanning. You may need to refresh the index if files are changed by other apps.
No software is perfect. We can\'t promise the app will always be error-free or uninterrupted.

Our total liability is capped at the total amount you paid for in-app purchases in the 30 days before any claim. We are not liable for data loss, device damage, or lost profits arising from free features.

string-array.name: tc_responsibilities
string-array.item: Keep regular backups of important files before performing bulk operations.
Store your Vault PIN and Recovery Code somewhere safe — we cannot retrieve them for you.
Keep your PIN private. Anyone who knows it can access your Vault.
Keep your network share credentials safe — they are stored locally on your device.
Review your Folder Sync remote paths carefully — syncing to an incorrect network folder may overwrite existing files.
Exercise caution when removing system apps based on debloat recommendations.
Only connect via ADB Terminal to devices you own or have explicit permission to access. Do not use ADB Terminal to gain unauthorized access to any device.
Keep any ADB or Shizuku pairing PINs private — share these only with people you trust to have access to your device.
Secure your Shizuku Manager — granting UFM elevated access via Shizuku gives it power over restricted files. Only grant this access if you trust the app.
Only use the app for lawful purposes. Don\'t store, share, or distribute illegal content.
Don\'t use Remote Management to access another person\'s device without their permission.
Don\'t attempt to reverse-engineer, decompile, or tamper with the app.
Manage your indexed records responsibly — you can delete records or ignore specific drives at any time via Settings -> Storage Indexer.
Verify the authenticity and safety of any APK files before installing them.

Ultimate File Manager Pro is an independent Android application and is not affiliated with, authorized, sponsored, or endorsed by the Ultimate File Manager project for Windows (ultimatefilemanager.pl) or any other product using a similar name. All other product names and trademarks are the property of their respective owners.\n\nThis Privacy Policy explains what information we collect when you use Ultimate File Manager Pro, how we use it, and how we keep it safe. By using the app, you agree to the practices described here.
Stored Locally on Your Device Only
The following data is saved on your device and never leaves it. We have zero access to any of this.
We have no access to your PIN, recovery code, encryption keys, or any files stored in your Vault — ever.
Collected via Firebase Analytics (Anonymous)

We use Google Firebase Analytics to collect anonymous data to improve the app. Analytics data is never linked to your personal identity. You can opt out at any time using the Usage Analytics toggle in the app\'s Settings, or via your Android device settings.
Processed via Google Play Billing (Optional Tips Only)

When you make an optional Tip Jar purchase, Google Play processes the transaction. We never see your card or bank details. We temporarily receive a purchase token and the product ID — both handled on-device only and never stored on our servers.
Anonymous purchase tokens from Google Play Billing are temporarily processed on-device to confirm your tip — they are never stored by us and are not linked to your identity.
What We Never Collect
Local Data Is Used To
Analytics Data Is Used To
Storage Permissions
Network Permissions

The Remote Management server, File Server hosting, SMB/FTP/SFTP/SCP network share connections, folder sync, device pairing, and ADB Terminal connections all operate on your local Wi-Fi network only. Remote Management and FTP servers use unencrypted protocols; SFTP and ADB Terminal connections use secure, encrypted protocols. Cloud storage APIs (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3-compatible) securely communicate with their respective servers over encrypted HTTPS. No other data is transmitted to external servers.
Other Permissions
Vault Encryption
The Encrypted Vault uses military-grade encryption to protect your files.
If you forget both your PIN and recovery code, your encrypted data is permanently inaccessible — not even we can recover it. Please keep these stored somewhere safe.
Local Data Protection
Remote Management Security
Ultimate File Manager Pro\'s use of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
When you connect your Google Drive account, the app accesses your Google user data only to provide the file management features you use directly within the app.
Google User Data — Google Drive API
What We Never Access from Your Google Account

We do not access your Gmail, Google Contacts, Google Calendar, Google Photos (outside of Drive), or any other Google service data. Only the minimum Drive file data required for your requested action is ever accessed.
Permitted Uses of Google User Data
Prohibited Uses — We Never Use Google User Data For

Ultimate File Manager Pro requests only the minimum Google Drive permissions necessary to perform the file management actions you choose. We never request access to your Gmail, Google Contacts, Google Calendar, or any other Google service data.
Ultimate File Manager Pro integrates the RClone backend to support connecting to over 100 cloud storage providers. All configurations and credentials are managed directly on your device.

When you use the RClone storage integration in Ultimate File Manager Pro, the app processes your cloud storage credentials and file metadata locally. The app communicates directly with your chosen cloud storage provider\'s API endpoint. We do not intermediate this connection, and we never collect, store, or transmit your cloud credentials or files to our servers.
Local Credential Encryption

Any passwords, tokens, or API keys entered for RClone storage configurations are obscured and encrypted using on-device cryptography via the RClone RC backend and stored securely as rclone_encrypted.json in the app\'s private directory. This file is inaccessible to other applications and is permanently deleted when you uninstall the app.
Permitted Uses of Cloud Data

string-array.item: Remote Browsing: Retrieving folder structures and file metadata to display your remote cloud storage contents.
File Operations: Uploading, downloading, renaming, copying, moving, or deleting files on your remote storage at your explicit request.

resources.string: We do not sell, rent, trade, transfer, or disclose your personal information or Google user data to any third party for any purpose not directly related to providing Ultimate File Manager Pro\'s file management features — full stop.
Third-Party Services We Use
When you choose to open or share a file with another app — including via the Storage Access Framework (SAF) document provider — that app\'s own privacy policy governs what it does with the file.

We may also disclose information if required by law, court order, or government request, to the extent permitted by applicable law. We do not transfer or disclose your personal information or Google user data to third parties for purposes other than those described in this Privacy Policy.
You are in control of your data. Here\'s what you can do at any time.
How to Delete All App Data
Clearing data or uninstalling will delete your Vault PIN, recovery code, and encryption keys — making any Vault contents permanently inaccessible. Decrypt everything you want to keep first.

Ultimate File Manager Pro is not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal information, please contact us.

Ultimate File Manager Pro is developed in South Africa. If you\'re using the app from another country, please note that any information may be processed in South Africa or in countries where our third-party service providers (like Google) operate.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we\'ll update the date at the top. For significant changes, we\'ll also notify you in-app. Continuing to use the app after changes means you accept the updated Policy.

This app is built to meet Google Play\'s standards. All requested permissions are required for core app functionality. Before requesting any sensitive permission, the app clearly explains why it\'s needed and how it will be used. Regarding the October 2024 Photo and Video Policy updates: broad access is necessary because this is a comprehensive file manager designed for bulk operations (moving, renaming, and syncing) across all storage volumes, which cannot be efficiently performed using standard system pickers.
If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please reach out.
By using Ultimate File Manager Pro, you confirm that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy.
